lines.en: label makotospecial50:
scene unbluejay1
Redbirds bleed and blue ones die — that’s the nature of this world of mine.
lines.zh: 红鸟流血，蓝鸟死去——这就是我的世界的本质。

lines.en: The green ones sing, the yellows cry — yet still the redbirds bleed. But why?
lines.zh: 绿鸟歌唱，黄鸟哭泣——可红鸟依旧在流血。究竟为什么？

lines.en: I close my book. Breathe out a sigh. Then pierce the glass with both my eyes.
lines.zh: 我合上书。叹一口气。然后用双眼刺穿玻璃。

lines.en: Approach the window, scan the sky — beneath the clouds, above the pines.
lines.zh: 走近窗前，扫视天际——云层之下，松林之上。

lines.en: The blue ones fall as the red ones rise. Don’t ask me how, I won’t reply.
lines.zh: 蓝鸟坠落，红鸟升起。别问我怎么做到的，我不会回答。

lines.en: I can’t tell you why the cardinals fly. I can’t tell you why the blues won’t try.
lines.zh: 我说不出红雀为何飞翔。我说不出蓝雀为何不肯一试。

lines.en: I can’t tell you anything as I-
lines.zh: 我什么也说不出来，因为我——

lines.en: I hate this fucking world of mine.
lines.zh: 我恨这个他妈的属于我的世界。

lines.en: I hate the birds. I hate the sky. I hate paper, pencils, crooked lines.
lines.zh: 我恨那些鸟。我恨天空。我恨纸、铅笔、歪歪扭扭的线。

lines.en: These are reasons why I sometimes try imagining that I am blind.
lines.zh: 这些都是我有时会幻想自己双目失明的原因。

lines.en: I know there’s beauty here.
lines.zh: 我知道这里有美。

lines.en: There has to be.
lines.zh: 一定有。

lines.en: It’s just way too hard to find.
lines.zh: 只是太难找到了。

lines.en: : Helloooo? Senseiiiii? Did you forget that you’re supposed to be {i}working{/i} right now?
lines.zh: : 喂————？Sensei————？你是不是忘了你现在应该在{i}干活{/i}？

lines.en: : Forget? No. Ignore? Yes.
lines.zh: : 忘了？没有。当作没看见？是的。

lines.en: : Well, on the bright side, you’re almost done. I just need your signature on a few more forms and you can go back to being irresponsible and lazy like you always are.
lines.zh: : 嗯，往好处想，你快干完了。我只需要你在最后几张表上签个字，你就可以继续像往常一样不负责任又懒散了。

lines.en: : Why haven’t you just started forging my signature on everything yet? That would save both of us so much time.
lines.zh: : 你怎么还没开始在每份文件上伪造我的签名？那能省我们俩多少时间啊。

lines.en: : Because I’m honest. Which is also why I don’t mind admitting that these paper-relays of ours are some of the very few moments we share that actually count as bonding in my book.
lines.zh: : 因为我很诚实。也正因如此，我不介意承认——我们这种「传纸接力」，是我俩为数不多能算得上增进感情的相处时光。

lines.en: : Does it not count as bonding when I put my penis inside of you?
lines.zh: : 我把阴茎插进你身体里的时候，就不算增进感情了？

lines.en: : It used to. Now, that’s more akin to something like cracking my knuckles or yawning. Just a standard bodily function. The novelty has worn off.
lines.zh: : 以前算。现在嘛，那更像是掰手指关节或者打哈欠之类的。就是一项标准的生理功能。新鲜感早就没了。

lines.en: : What am I even signing anyway? Why are there so many more sheets of paper than normal?
lines.zh: : 我到底在签什么？为什么纸比平时多了这么多？

lines.en: : Because you have twenty different students who all just finished their standardized tests — which, and this may come as a big surprise to you, are a {i}little{/i} more in-depth than just one sheet of paper.
lines.zh: : 因为你有二十个不同的学生刚刚考完标准化考试——说起来可能会让你大吃一惊，那东西比一张纸要{i}复杂那么一点点{/i}。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I believe you. I feel like you might just be handing me blank sheets of paper in order to pad the numbers of our “bonding time.”
lines.zh: : 我不知道该不该信你。我觉得你可能是故意递给我一堆白纸，好给我们的「增进感情时间」凑数。

lines.en: scene unbluejay2
: Are you seriously not even looking at them? They’re very clearly not blank.
lines.zh: : 你真的连看都不看一眼吗？这上面明明不是空白的。

lines.en: : They look blank to me. But that’s probably just because I’ve gotten so used to tuning everything out that the words don’t even register anymore.
lines.zh: : 在我看来就是空白的。不过大概是因为我已经习惯把所有东西都屏蔽掉，连字都进不了脑子了。

lines.en: : That is both very sad and very impressive. I wish I could care as little as you.
lines.zh: : 这既可悲又厉害。我真希望自己也能像你这么不在乎。

lines.en: : You did for a little while. What happened to that Makoto? How do we bring {i}her{/i} back?
lines.zh: : 你有过一阵子就是这样。那个 Makoto 去哪了？怎么才能把{i}她{/i}弄回来？

lines.en: scene unbluejay3
: Easy! By killing someone else who’s important to me.
lines.zh: : 简单！再杀掉一个对我很重要的人就行了。

lines.en: : Pass. Too much effort. Also, your mom would have been proud of that joke.
lines.zh: : 算了。太麻烦。还有，你妈会为这个笑话骄傲的。

lines.en: scene unbluejay4
: Ahh, my poor mother...I remember her like it was yesterday. What a shame that she, too-
lines.zh: : 啊，我可怜的妈妈……我对她的记忆还像昨天一样清晰。真可惜，她也——

lines.en: : I’m glad you’re feeling better, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你现在感觉好些了，Makoto。

lines.en: scene unbluejay5
: Huh?
: I said I’m glad you’re feeling better.
lines.zh: : 我说，我很高兴你现在感觉好些了。

lines.en: : Are you saying that because you mean it? Or because you think I’ll take it easy on you and let you finish signing things early because you showed me the slightest bit of sentimentality?
lines.zh: : 你说这话是真心的？还是觉得只要你稍微露出一点点温情，我就会对你网开一面，让你早点签完？

lines.en: : ...Both?
lines.zh: : ……都有吧？

lines.en: scene unbluejay6
: Just sign the last few papers, Sensei. We’re almost done.
lines.zh: : 把最后几份签了吧，Sensei。我们快结束了。

lines.en: : I will sign {i}one{/i} more. The rest can wait until tomorrow. My hand hurts.
lines.zh: : 我再签{i}一份{/i}。剩下的可以等明天。我手疼。

lines.en: : Just one? Really?
lines.zh: : 就一份？真的假的？

lines.en: : Choose wisely, Makoto. Whose grades matter the most?
lines.zh: : 慎重选择，Makoto。谁的成绩最重要？

lines.en: scene unbluejay7
: Hmm...just {i}one,{/i} huh?
lines.zh: : 嗯……就{i}一份{/i}啊？

lines.en: : But there are at least eighty more that need to be signed.
lines.zh: : 可至少还有八十份等着签字呢。

lines.en: : I thought you said we were-
lines.zh: : 我记得你说我们——

lines.en: scene unbluejay8
: Here! Sign this one!
lines.zh: : 给！签这份！

lines.en: : Final answer?
lines.zh: : 不改了？

lines.en: : Final answer.
lines.zh: : 不改了。

lines.en: scene unbluejay9
I take the “final” paper from Makoto and, after looking at it for almost a full second, I spot her name and realize that there was really only one option available to her in the first place.
lines.zh: 我从 Makoto 手里接过这份「最后」的纸，看了将近整整一秒，就看到了她的名字，然后意识到她一开始其实只有一个选择。

lines.en: Then, as I sign my name along the bottom section of the document, I silently applaud her for her selfishness as it is one of several things we have in common.
lines.zh: 接着，当我在文件底部签下自己的名字时，我在心里默默为她的自私鼓掌——那是我们为数不多的共同点之一。

lines.en: The other things being poor vision and a burning passion for rough sex — even if she claims it isn’t much of a big deal anymore.
lines.zh: 其他的还有视力差，以及对粗暴性爱的狂热——尽管她现在声称那已经不算什么大不了的事了。

lines.en: : Okay. Done.
lines.zh: : 好了。签完了。

lines.en: scene unbluejay10
: Thank you for your service.
lines.zh: : 感谢你的付出。

lines.en: : It was hard, but I’m glad we made it through the day.
lines.zh: : 很艰难，不过我很高兴我们撑过了一天。

lines.en: scene unbluejay11
: It’s been approximately fifteen minutes since I came in here.
lines.zh: : 我进来到现在，大概才十五分钟。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you were there for the rest of the day so the statement stands. But anyway, what now? Want to engage in “bodily functions” on the couch?
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你这一天剩下的时间都在，所以这话照样成立。话说回来，现在干嘛？想在沙发上做点「生理功能」吗？

lines.en: : That sounded absolutely disgusting even if I knew what you meant.
lines.zh: : 就算我知道你想说什么，那听起来也恶心透了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 嗯，抱歉。

lines.en: scene unbluejay12
: Would it be selfish of me to ask if I can have you for a little while longer?
lines.zh: : 如果我问能不能再把你要过来多待一会儿，会不会显得我很自私？

lines.en: : Yes. But I was actually just thinking about how I like your selective brand of selfishness, so go ahead and have me. But I’d still prefer the couch over-
lines.zh: : 会。可我刚才正好在想，我还挺喜欢你那种挑着来的自私，所以拿去吧。不过比起别的，我还是更想在沙发上——

lines.en: scene unbluejay13
: Not here.
lines.zh: : 不是在这儿。

lines.en: : There’s somewhere else I want to go.
lines.zh: : 我想去别的地方。

lines.en: scene black
scene unbluejay14
It becomes fairly evident that Makoto was asking to “have” me in a more {i}hands-free{/i} sort of way the moment we make it up to the rooftop.
lines.zh: 我们一到天台就相当明显了——Makoto 说要「拥有」我，其实是那种{i}不用动手{/i}的拥有。

lines.en: Either that or she’s just into the same sort of stuff Ayane is. Which, honestly, wouldn’t be all that surprising since Ayane’s only fetish seems to just be {i}me{/i} as a whole.
lines.zh: 又或者，她只是跟 Ayane 好同一口。说实话，那也不怎么令人意外，毕竟 Ayane 唯一的癖好似乎就是「{i}我{/i}」这个整体。

lines.en: The air is warm, but not warm enough to make me regret coming out here. It’s one of those days where you’re acutely aware that it {i}is{/i} summer, but...
lines.zh: 空气很暖，但还没暖到让我后悔出来。这是那种让人异常清醒地意识到「现在{i}是{/i}夏天」的日子，只是……

lines.en: Well, if I didn’t know any better, I’d say this is a little closer to spring.
lines.zh: 嗯，要是不懂的话，我会说这更接近春天一点。

lines.en: Makoto skips closer to the fence, causing her skirt to bounce along with her “perverted adjective, followed by perverted noun.”
lines.zh: Makoto 蹦跳着靠近围栏，裙摆随之晃动，还有她那对「色情形容词＋色情名词」也跟着晃。

lines.en: And, in other news, signing so many papers in one sitting has drained the last bit of motivation I have left in my body.
lines.zh: 另外插播一条：一口气签了这么多文件，已经把我身体里最后一点干劲抽干了。

lines.en: It is all downhill from here.
lines.zh: 从此一路下坡。

lines.en: : This weather’s amazing, isn’t it? And the sky is so bright.
lines.zh: : 这天气真好啊，不是吗？天空也这么亮。

lines.en: : It’s probably symbolism.
lines.zh: : 大概是什么象征吧。

lines.en: scene unbluejay15
: Is it? For what?
lines.zh: : 是吗？象征什么？

lines.en: : Maybe this...newer...bubbly front you’re putting on.
lines.zh: : 也许是……你现在摆出来的这副……新的、元气满满的样子。

lines.en: : It’s not a front, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那不是装出来的，Sensei。

lines.en: : The skies are just starting to clear up a little.
lines.zh: : 只是天开始放晴了一点而已。

lines.en: : I knew it was symbolism. I told you.
lines.zh: : 我就知道是象征。我都说了。

lines.en: : I will take that as a passing grade on this impromptu weather-based and somewhat-literary evaluation test. Thank you very much.
lines.zh: : 那我就当这是在这场以天气为题、略带文学性的即兴测验里拿了个及格分。非常感谢。

lines.en: : Let’s hope it lasts this time and that no further tragedy follows the customarily tragic life of Makoto Miyamura.
lines.zh: : 希望这次能持续下去，别再有什么新的悲剧追着 Makoto Miyamura 那一贯悲惨的人生来了。

lines.en: scene unbluejay16
: Even if it does, I think I’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 就算来了，我觉得我也能扛住。

lines.en: : The worst has passed. Things couldn’t possibly be that bad ever again without me losing a child or something. And I’m not even sure if I want kids.
lines.zh: : 最糟的已经过去了。以后再糟也糟不到哪去，除非我再失去一个孩子什么的。而我连自己想不想要孩子都还没想好。

lines.en: : You don’t.
lines.zh: : 你不想要。

lines.en: : You’re only saying that because {i}you{/i} don’t want kids.
lines.zh: : 你这么说只是因为{i}你自己{/i}不想要孩子。

lines.en: : Why would I ever say anything that doesn’t directly relate to me? That just sounds like a waste of time.
lines.zh: : 我为什么要说跟我完全没有直接关系的话？那听起来纯粹是浪费时间。

lines.en: : Narcissism and uncertain futures aside, I hope you’re right. I’ve had enough tragedy for one school year.
lines.zh: : 自恋和看不清的未来先放一边，我希望你是对的。一个学年里的悲剧，我已经受够了。

lines.en: : Actually, I’ve probably had enough for my entire high school career. So yeah, let’s hang it up for now.
lines.zh: : 事实上，大概够我整个高中生涯受的了。所以，没错，先收起来吧。

lines.en: : Back to the original plan then? Working hard and just doing your own thing with little regard for your own sanity and how everyone else feels about you?
lines.zh: : 那就回到原来的计划？努力干活，只顾自己，不太在乎自己的精神状态，也不在乎别人怎么看你？

lines.en: : Maybe.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: : I’m trying not to think about it.
lines.zh: : 我在尽量不去想。

lines.en: : I just kind of want to exist right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在只是想单纯地存在着。

lines.en: scene black
: And whatever that entails is fine by me.
lines.zh: : 不管这意味着什么，我都接受。

lines.en: : Makoto? Where are you going?
lines.zh: : Makoto？你要去哪？

lines.en: : Hm? Higher. To get a better view of the city.
lines.zh: : 嗯？往高处。想看得清这座城市一点。

lines.en: : Want to follow me up? Or would you rather stay down there on the ground like a pansy?
lines.zh: : 要跟上来吗？还是你想像个娘娘腔一样待在下面地上？

lines.en: Being an alpha-male who is most assuredly not a “pansy,” I follow Makoto up the ladder until we’re level with the fence...
lines.zh: 作为一个绝绝对对不是「娘娘腔」的 alpha 男性，我跟着 Makoto 爬上梯子，直到我们和围栏齐平……

lines.en: scene unbluejay17
A fall from this high up would certainly kill us, and I need to think for a moment about whether or not my incessant beratement of Makoto would prompt her to end my life.
lines.zh: 从这么高摔下去肯定会死，我得想一会儿——我对 Makoto 没完没了的挖苦，会不会促使她来结束我的生命。

lines.en: : I’m really happy you’re here, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我真的很高兴你在这儿，Sensei。

lines.en: She attempts to lure me into a false sense of security.
lines.zh: 她试图把我引诱进一种虚假的安全感里。

lines.en: : Is that only because you brought me up here to murder me?
lines.zh: : 这难道只是因为你把我带到这儿来杀我？

lines.en: I subtly let her know that I’m onto her.
lines.zh: 我微妙地让她知道，我已经看穿她了。

lines.en: : No. It’s because there’s no one I’d rather look out over this horizon with than you.
lines.zh: : 不是。因为能和我一起眺望这片天际线的人，没有谁比你更合适了。

lines.en: : It feels almost nostalgic in a way, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 某种意义上，这感觉还挺怀旧的，不是吗？

lines.en: : Well, yeah. We’ve been up here before.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊。我们以前上来过。

lines.en: : That was a long time ago, though.
lines.zh: : 不过那是很久以前的事了。

lines.en: : A lot has happened since then, huh?
lines.zh: : 从那以后发生了好多事，对吧？

lines.en: : More than you know, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 比你想象的多得多，Makoto。

lines.en: : Do you think I’ll make a good teacher one day?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我以后能当个好老师吗？

lines.en: : I think you make a good teacher right now. I worry about how “good” you’ll be once you’re done with college.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你现在就已经是个好老师了。我担心的是你读完大学之后会「好」成什么样。

lines.en: : I really hope I can be like you one day. Just without all of the statutory rape. And lack of motivation. And built-in cynicism.
lines.zh: : 我真的很希望有一天能成为像你一样的人。只是不要有那些法定强奸。也不要那么没干劲。还有那套与生俱来的愤世嫉俗。

lines.en: : So basically, you just want to have my job title.
lines.zh: : 说白了，你只是想要我这个职位名称。

lines.en: : And the ability to motivate people. Yes.
lines.zh: : 还有激励别人的能力。对。

lines.en: : I don’t motivate anyone, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 我可激励不了任何人，Makoto。

lines.en: scene unbluejay18
: You don’t {i}try{/i} to motivate anyone. But the weird and unfortunate truth is that you unintentionally {i}do.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你是没{i}试着{/i}去激励谁。可奇怪又可悲的事实是，你无意中{i}做到了{/i}。

lines.en: : Though, I guess it’s possible that we’re all so desperate to end up as someone unlike you that seeing you struggle gets us to “wake up.”
lines.zh: : 不过，我想也许是因为我们都太想成为跟你不一样的人，所以看到你挣扎，反而让我们「醒过来」了。

lines.en: : Have we entered the arc where {i}you{/i} bully {i}me{/i} now?
lines.zh: : 我们现在是进入{i}你{/i}欺负{i}我{/i}的篇章了吗？

lines.en: scene unbluejay19
: Possibly. All things considered, I’m definitely not the same girl I was the last time we were up here.
lines.zh: : 有可能。综合来看，我确实已经不是上次我们来这儿时的那个女孩了。

lines.en: : What kind of girl that {i}makes{/i} me, I have no idea. But I know I’ve gotta get it together if I want to keep looking up at the clouds like this.
lines.zh: : 那让我{i}成了{/i}什么样的女孩，我不知道。但我知道，如果我想继续像这样抬头看云，就得振作起来。

lines.en: : For a while, well before everything with my dad happened, the sky lost its color. It was this...huge blanket of gray that made everything beneath it look lifeless and dull.
lines.zh: : 有那么一阵子，早在我爸出事之前很久，天空失去了颜色。那是一整块……巨大的灰色毯子，把它下面的一切都衬得毫无生气、暗淡无光。

lines.en: : I thought about leaving a ton of times.
lines.zh: : 我想过很多次要离开。

lines.en: : I went as far as writing notes. To you. To my mom. To Miku. I even wrote one to Ami once — but even that was mostly about you.
lines.zh: : 我甚至写好了遗书。写给你的。写给我妈的。写给 Miku 的。我还给 Ami 写过一次——可就连那封，大部分也是关于你的。

lines.en: : Makoto-
lines.zh: : Makoto——

lines.en: : I thought about coming up here, throwing myself off of this roof, and letting life move on without me because I just didn’t have what it takes to keep going.
lines.zh: : 我想过上来这里，从这屋顶跳下去，让生活在没有我的情况下继续，因为我就是没有撑下去的本事。

lines.en: scene unbluejay20
: I still think about it sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我到现在有时候还是会想。

lines.en: : About what would have happened if I had followed through.
lines.zh: : 想如果当时真的做了，会怎么样。

lines.en: : I think about what would happen to my mom and the store.
lines.zh: : 想我妈和那家店会变成什么样。

lines.en: : I think about what would happen to Miku’s grades.
lines.zh: : 想 Miku 的成绩会变成什么样。

lines.en: : Or if you’d blame yourself for it even though it was never your fault.
lines.zh: : 还想你会不会为此自责，尽管那从来都不是你的错。

lines.en: : This is the way I’ve always been. And hey, maybe I’ll be this way forever — never totally sure of whether or not there’s a purpose out there for someone like me.
lines.zh: : 我一直都是这样。而且，也许我这辈子都会是这样——永远无法真正确定，这世上到底有没有一个属于我这种人的位置。

lines.en: : But that’s okay...because I know the end of my suffering would just spell {i}more{/i} suffering for all of those people I wrote to.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系……因为我知道，我的痛苦结束了，只会给那些我写过信的人带来{i}更多{/i}痛苦。

lines.en: : So one of my new goals is to prevent anyone I care about from ever having to read anything like that.
lines.zh: : 所以我的新目标之一，就是让我在乎的人永远不必读到那样的东西。

lines.en: : I don’t want anyone else to ever have to feel the way I do.
lines.zh: : 我不想让任何人再体会到我这样的感受。

lines.en: scene unbluejay21
: Sorry...that probably wasn’t as happy of an ending as you were hoping for, was it?
lines.zh: : 抱歉……这个结尾大概不如你期待的那么圆满吧？

lines.en: : No, it really wasn’t...
lines.zh: : 不，真的不是……

lines.en: : I expected something more along the lines of “I want to be here now because I’ve found what it means to be happy” or whatever.
lines.zh: : 我预想的更像是「我现在想待在这里，因为我找到了快乐的意义」之类的话。

lines.en: : That sure would be nice, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那当然好了，不是吗？

lines.en: : And...who knows? Maybe some day, I’ll be able to think that way. But for now-
lines.zh: : 而且……谁知道呢？也许有一天，我也能那样想。但现在——

lines.en: : You just want to exist.
lines.zh: : 你只是想单纯地存在着。

lines.en: scene unbluejay22
: That’s right...
lines.zh: : 没错……

lines.en: : But in a way, for someone who’s always setting the bar so high, maybe a little goal like this will be easier for me to climb over?
lines.zh: : 不过换个角度想，对于一个总是把标准定得很高的人来说，也许这么小的一个目标，反而更容易让我跨过去？

lines.en: : I have no one to succeed for anymore other than myself.
lines.zh: : 除了我自己，我已经没有什么人需要我去为他们成功了。

lines.en: : If I look at it that way, I won’t have to push myself so hard.
lines.zh: : 这样想的话，我就不用把自己逼得那么紧。

lines.en: : And if I don’t push myself so hard, I’ll have more time to focus on what I know matters more than anything else.
lines.zh: : 而如果不把自己逼那么紧，我就有更多时间专注于我知道比什么都重要的东西上。

lines.en: : And that is?
lines.zh: : 那是什么？

lines.en: : Not writing any more notes.
lines.zh: : 不再写那样的信。

lines.en: : And learning how to smile from the bottom of my heart instead of the pit of my stomach.
lines.zh: : 还有，学会从心底里笑出来，而不是从胃的深处。

lines.en: : I’m really happy you’re here, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 我真的很高兴你在这儿，Makoto。

lines.en: scene unbluejay23
: Hey. That was {i}my{/i} line. You can’t just go plagiarizing me as soon as there’s an awkward silence.
lines.zh: : 喂。那是{i}我的{/i}台词。你不能一出现尴尬的沉默就抄袭我。

lines.en: : Sure I can. And until you’re the one in my position, you can’t tell me what to do.
lines.zh: : 我当然能。而且在你坐到我的位置之前，你管不着我。

lines.en: scene unbluejay24
: I can’t?
lines.zh: : 管不着？

lines.en: : You can’t.
lines.zh: : 管不着。

lines.en: : Bummer.
lines.zh: : 真扫兴。

lines.en: : Can I at least ask for a little favor, though?
lines.zh: : 那我至少能求你帮个小忙吧？

lines.en: : I’m done grading papers until tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 我批卷子要到明天才继续。

lines.en: : It’s not that. It’s something else.
lines.zh: : 不是那个。是别的事。

lines.en: : What is it?
lines.zh: : 什么事？

lines.en: scene black
: Can you close your eyes for a second?
lines.zh: : 你能闭一会儿眼睛吗？

lines.en: scene unbluejay25
Redbirds bleed and blue ones die — that’s the nature of this world of mine.
lines.zh: 红鸟流血，蓝鸟死去——这就是我的世界的本质。

lines.en: There’s no song to sing nor hymn to cry — just an aching heart and wat’ry eyes.
lines.zh: 没有歌可以唱，也没有赞美诗可以泣——只有一颗疼痛的心和一双含泪的眼。

lines.en: I hate love and lust and God and lies. I hate hummingbirds. The word “Goodbye.”
lines.zh: 我恨爱与欲，恨上帝与谎言。我恨蜂鸟。恨「再见」这个词。

lines.en: But if you’d ask me now, beneath this sky-
lines.zh: 但如果你现在在这片天空之下问我——

lines.en: I could tell you why the cardinals fly.
lines.zh: 我能告诉你红雀为何飞翔。

lines.en: scene black

$ makoto_love += 5
{i}Makoto’s affection has increased by 5!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Makoto 的好感度提升了 5 点！{/i}
